correctness.rationale: The spherical Bessel addition identity and orthogonality yield the exact radial inverse transform of j_k squared; Plancherel gives the finite Legendre-square integral with correct pi normalization. Finite terminating binomial expansion gives every rational coefficient. Splitting the angular integral at k^{-1+epsilon} and pi/2, and using uniform Darboux/Bernstein bounds, rigorously yields the leading logarithmic ratio 1. Exact small-k computations, independent quadratures and truncated Bessel integrals in CHECK.py pass; finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The degree-k Bessel quartic moment is the exact modal invariant in sharp radial-angular Fourier extension for d=3 and q=4, not an arbitrary chosen integral. The all-degree rational formula makes the precise constants reproducible and the asymptotic reveals log-enhanced K^{-1/4} high-degree attenuation. This quantifies a natural high-angular-frequency regime that general qualitative decay and modal ordering statements do not quantify; no claim to a general new restriction theorem is made.
